name: Conec2
summary: Melbourne telecom/IT group (CEO Cameron Adams; core business from 2008); bought ispONE assets Sep 2013 (via AsiaPAC), collapsed May 2014 after iBoss/One Telecom went to Vocus (CONEC2 Pty Ltd, ACN 131 677 588).

events.details: Melbourne telecom/IT group under CEO Cameron Adams; core telecommunications business launched 2008.

refs.label: iTnews (Sep 2013): Conec2 core business launched 2008, strong growth since

events.details: Acquired ispONE assets from Ferrier Hodgson (29 staff, 61,000 customers, DSL, iBOSS platform; price confidential, debt excluded) via subsidiary AsiaPAC Communications; took over Aldi Mobile (Medion) services; brands ONEseniors, One Mobile, One Telecom. Kogan Mobile not included.

refs.label: iTnews (Sep 2013): Conec2 acquires ispONE assets via AsiaPAC, ex-debt
CommsWire (Sep 2013): Aldi Mobile continues under Conec2; Kogan excluded

events.details: iBoss + One Telecom (50,000 customers) sold to Vocus after a Swindells/Adams court deadlock forced administration; Conec2 left with $4-6M AAPT/Telstra debts and entered administration, keeping ~2,500 small-business customers.

refs.label: iTnews (May 2014): iBoss/One Telecom to Vocus; Conec2 into administration
ABR: CONEC2 Pty Ltd ACN 131 677 588 (ABN cancelled)
